'''M'Nis''' was the tallest [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peak located on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], rising some 8,100 meters tall. Its name translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as "Skyfang".
